in_sanskrit.name: शूरेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Surendr is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘shu’ which means ‘brave’, ‘rend’ which means ‘to render’ or ‘to fight’, and ‘raja’ which means ‘king’. The name can be interpreted as ‘the brave king’ or ‘the heroic king’. It is a powerful and regal name that signifies strength, courage, and leadership.
